translated_text: My dear wife, listen, I'm waiting for Pezenas on May 22, 1940, as soon as possible. If it's possible, leave right away. Take the money you need, but leave plenty of time for the journey. Don't drive fast and be very careful. It would be very nice with Bubi Bubi, because he can drive. But—and this is very important—don't drive another kilometer in this car without a complete overhaul. Check the brakes, etc. It's better to give 50 francs upfront, then 300 francs after. Rooms. We'll see here. There's no danger if you hurry. So don't stay until the last minute. I kiss you a thousand times, goodbye Bob. See you soon. wal REGIMENT * D'INF The Postmaster CHECOSLO Madame HE 08 FM POSTES E. Zweigenthal 6 9 bis rue Brancion Paris 15 poste restante Pezenas (Hérault) Zweigenthal Cras Cours Jean Jaurès, c. reg. Vel. Rosa Pezenas (Hérault) PE
